lines.en: Once again, I find myself knocking on the door of a girl who wants nothing to do with me.
But, for reasons beyond my comprehension, I’m drawn to her. Like she’s a flickering light and I’m a...moth or some other fitting metaphor.
Why do I feel the need to get poetic all of a sudden? This is Yumi we're talking about.
: Yumi, let me in. I’m having a potentially uncharacteristic inner-monologue.
: Huh? The fuck are you talkin’ about? Get the hell out of here.
: You know I’m not going to do that. Just open the door.
: No! Fuck off!
Or maybe a cushion. Who knows? Does it even matter?
: Delivery for Yumi Yamaguchi.
: Oh my fucking God.
: I have the pizza you ordered.
: JESUS, OKAY! HOLD ON A FUCKING SECOND, WOULD YOU?
After a moment, the door opens and Yumi begrudgingly lets me in.
: What?...
: You look really cute.
: Bullshit! I do not! It’s just a track jacket and pants. Do you have some...weird fetish for overly-clothed girls or something?!
: You shouldn't belittle people for their fetishes, Yumi. It's unbecoming.
: I'll do whatever the fuck I want, thank you very much. Now why are you here?
: Are you going to try to get me to talk to you again? Cause I’m not really in a talkin’ mood right now.
: Did something happen?
: Yeah. This weird guy keeps followin’ me around and I’m pretty sure he’s going to [rape] me.
: That sounds horrible. Where did he go? I’ll take him down.
Of course I know she’s talking about me. But if she was actually concerned about me doing something horrible to her, why would she have opened the door in the first place?
: Relax. You're safe here.
: I'd sure fucking hope so. It's my room.
: Though, I guess you've proven you really don't give a shit about that so far.
: So, what's the plan? Are we going to sit here in silence for the rest of the night and stare at each other?
: You know, if you're bored, you can leave whenever the fuck you want. It’s not like I actually want you here or anything.
: Woah, calm down there, tsundere. You’re about to confine yourself to a particular archetype.
: I’m not a fucking tsundere! I genuinely do not want you here! I was about to go to sleep!
: Sleep? But it’s only 8PM. Chika’s not even home yet.
: Well, what else was I gonna do?! I don’t have a laptop to fuck around with and I can’t figure out the password to Chika’s!
: I thought about goin’ for a walk or whatever but then I figured that’s what you would be doin’ since you’re apparently obsessed with stalking me now.
: But now you’re here anyway so I obviously made the wrong decision!
: We can go for a walk if you want. Is there anywhere you want to go?
: No...ugh. We can just...fucking stay here...
: I’m already in my pajamas. I don’t want to get dressed again.
: I might get attacked.
To be frank, I'm already having a hard time not attacking her.
But this is also my first time seeing Yumi in her pajamas, so I think I should be forgiven for any impure thoughts I may or may not be having.
Sure, the words “Fuck You” are still looming in the background on her dry-erase board, but I feel like Yumi’s actually a little calmer today than usual.
: I guess we’ll stay here then. Do you want to, like...watch a movie or something?
: How? I just fuckin’ told you I don’t have the password to Chika’s laptop.
: Also, stop pretending we’re friends just because I let you inside my room!
I direct my attention to a bunch of old-looking TVs on a warehouse-style shelf near the door.
I’m not sure why either of these things are here, but I’m assuming at least one of the TVs needs to work, right?...
: Why do you have all of these?
: What’s it matter to you?
: Just...seems like a strange thing to collect.
: I’m not fuckin’ collecting ‘em! I sell these!
: Who in their right mind is buying old TVs from you?
: I don’t know! Pawn shops...old people like you tryin’ to remember their childhood. Whoever!
: Aren’t there easier ways to earn money, though?
: What, like getting an actual job? Isn’t that off limits for students?
: Yeah, but that hasn’t really stopped anybody else.
: Okay, but who the fuck is gonna hire somebody like me? You know the way I talk.
: I’m not workin’ material. I have to do shit like this or I can’t afford to eat.
: Your parents don’t give you money for food?
: I don’t really talk to my parents. Fuck them.
: They’re assholes anyway! Maybe even worse than you! Who needs ‘em?
: Besides, it’s not like I’m fuckin' starving or whatever. I still eat pretty much every day.
: Pretty much?
: Well, yeah. You don’t need to eat every day. All you really need is water.
: Is that why you have so many water bottles on your side of the room?
: Sh-shut up! They’re all empty! I just didn’t feel like cleanin’ em up!
: I walked all over town today and my legs are fuckin’ dead, so forgive me for not gettin' rid of some stupid bottles.
: I didn't mention that it was a mess...I just noticed there was a lot of water, that’s all.
: Well...whatever. You said you wanted to know shit about me and now you know one thing. Is that enough for you to fuck off?
: No, actually. In fact, I’m probably even more worried about you now.
: The fuck is there to worry about?! I’m fine!
: You’re most definitely not fine. You’re malnourished and I’m pretty sure it’s causing your attitude to deteriorate.
: That’s just my fuckin' attitude...What I eat has nothin’ to do with it.
: If you really wanna help, just buy a fuckin’ TV.
: Where do you even get the TVs?
: My God! The questions never end with you! Does it matter?!
: Maybe I find ‘em on the side of the road! Maybe I steal ‘em! As long as it’s puttin’ food on the table, it shouldn’t fuckin' matter where they come from.
: I think you and I might need to do some job-hunting soon, Yumi.
: Yeah, well I think you should eat a fucking dick.
: Harsh.
: For real, though. Let’s try and figure out a way for you to be able to make ends meet without stealing or scavenging outdated television sets and-
: What’s all that other stuff on the desk? Candy?
: Yeah...Easier to sell, but doesn’t bring in as much cash.
: Not like I can survive off just eatin’ candy either, so none of that's for me.
: Okay well, either way, I’ll try and help you find some work.
: ...If you think I’m gonna suck your dick in exchange for helping me out or whatever, you’re fucking delusional. It’s not gonna happen.
: I didn’t even almost insinuate that.
: You don’t need to. You’ve made your motives pretty clear already, asshole.
: I just want you to be able to eat every day instead of “pretty much” every day.
: Sure, you might hate my guts, but you’re still my student.
: I might not be the best teacher out there-
: Might not be?
: Okay. I'm definitely not the best teacher out there, but I do know that I’m not supposed to let my students die of starvation.
: You really did get this job just to hang around [young_girls], didn’t you?
: The answer to that question is very complicated, so I am going to disregard it. The point is, we’re going to start the Yumi Revitalization Project.
: Heh?
: The Yumi-what now?
: The Yumi Revitalization Project. Coming soon to a Yumi near you.
: Are you high?
: High on passion.
: You’re a fucking lunatic.
: I never agreed to this.
: You don’t need to agree to it. I’ve decided this is best for you as your teacher.
: And if you disagree, I’ll report all of your absences to the principal.
: Wait...You mean...you haven’t already been doing that?
: Of course not. I don’t want you to fail.
There’s also the issue of me being held responsible if I report that she’s skipping literally every day, so...
: Uhh...I don’t really know what I’m supposed to say to that.
: Thanks...I guess?
: That’s...actually really cool of you.
: The fuck, dude? This is a receipt for coffee.
: I’m supposed to sign away my freedom on this?
: You’re not signing away your freedom. You’re just agreeing to go job hunting with me.
: But...what if they don’t like me? I don’t really have the best reputation around here...
: Then we’ll just find somewhere else.
: I’ll even buy you lunch or something whenever we go out. Free food doesn’t sound bad, right?
: Your happiness is more than enough payment for me, Yumi.
: Gross...
: Yeah. That was hard to say.
: Ugh...whatever. Fine.
: Free lunch doesn’t sound that bad anyway. And if I have a chance at gettin’ more money out of it, then...
: I guess I can stomach bein' near you a little more...
Yumi scribbles her name on the sheet of receipt paper and hands it back to me.
I try and stay for a while longer to chat with her about other things, but she manages to push me out of the room.
Eventually, I find myself walking back home. But not without a newly-formed contract between myself and the[school]-delinquent.
Here’s to hoping we can get her onto the right track soon enough.
Kudos to me for actually being a teacher for once.
Yumi’s affection has somehow increased to [yumi_love]!
You can now spend time with her in her room!
